label: Bhakti-Pratikūla-Bhāva Varjanāṅgīkāra Song Two
title: tuwā-bhakti-pratikūla dharma jā'te roy
metaDescription: Bhakti-Pratikūla-Bhāva Varjanāṅgīkāra Song Two (tuwā-bhakti-pratikūla dharma jā'te roy) of Śaraṇāgati (‘Surrender’) written by Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in 1893. This songbook contains 50 songs detailing the six symptoms of surrender unto the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

verses.translation: I will assuredly abandon with utmost endeavor all things in which aversion to Your devotional service is inherent.
I will not keep company with those opposed to Your devotional service, nor even look at the faces of those inimical toward Lord Gaurāṅga.

translit: bhaktira apriya kārye nāhi kori rati
verses.translation: I will never reside at a place unfavorable for devotional practices, and I will never take pleasure in non-devotional activities.
deva: भक्तिर अप्रिय कार्ये नाहि कोरि रति
bengali: ভক্তির অপ্রিয কার্যে নাহি কোরি রতি

translit: bhaktira virodhī grantha pāṭha nā koribo
bhaktira virodhī vyākhyā kabhu nā śunibo
deva: भक्तिर विरोधी ग्रन्थ पाठ ना कोरिबो
भक्तिर विरोधी व्याख्या कभु ना शुनिबो
bengali: ভক্তির বিরোধী গ্রন্থ পাঠ না কোরিবো
ভক্তির বিরোধী ব্যাখ্যা কভু না শুনিবো

verses.translation: I will never regard as sacred any place where Lord Gaurāṅga is rejected. All knowledge or action hindering pure devotional service I consider worthless.

translit: bhaktira bādhaka kāle nā kori ādar
verses.translation: Any seasonal observance which poses obstacles to the execution of devotional service finds no favor with me, and I consider as strangers all my own relatives or family members who are averse to devotional service.
deva: भक्तिर बाधक काले ना कोरि आदर्
bengali: ভক্তির বাধক কালে না কোরি আদর্

verses.translation: I will totally abandon all desires that hinder devotion, and I will never touch foodstuffs offered to me by non-devotees.

translit: tyajibo jatane tāhā, e niścoya vānī
verses.translation: I vow to carefully avoid whatever I know to be contrary to devotional service. This is a most definite proclamation.
deva: त्यजिबो जतने ताहा, ए निश्चोय वानी
bengali: ত্যজিবো জতনে তাহা, এ নিশ্চোয বানী

verses.translation: Bhaktivinoda falls down at the feet of the Lord and begs for the strength to give up all things that are unfavorable to pure devotion.
